description: We are Team ZELORA,  two enthusiastic students interested in space technology, artificial intelligence, data science, and innovative problem-solving. We enjoy turning real-world challenges into practical solutions using technology, data, and creative thinking.
summary: TerraCycle AI is an intelligent agricultural decision-support platform that integrates NASA satellite observations and local agricultural data to help farmers make sustainable crop rotation decisions. The system analyzes rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, and vegetation health using NASA data sources such as POWER, GPM, SMAP, and MODIS. It uses an explainable AI-based scoring engine to evaluate and compare different crop rotation strategies based on water requirements, climate suitability, soil improvement, nitrogen-fixing potential, and economic benefits. The platform also identifies unused growing periods, simulates climate change scenarios, and provides personalized crop recommendations to improve soil fertility, optimize resource usage, and build climate-resilient farming practices
details: TerraCycle AI is an AI-powered agricultural decision-support platform that uses NASA satellite data to help farmers make sustainable crop rotation decisions. It analyzes rainfall, temperature, soil moisture, and vegetation health to identify environmental risks and recommend suitable crop rotations. It benefits farmers by improving soil fertility, optimizing water usage, and reducing climate-related risks. The project aims to promote sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture. We used React.js, Vite, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Leaflet, Recharts, and NASA POWER, GPM, SMAP, and MODIS datasets. Its creativity lies in combining satellite-based environmental monitoring, explainable AI recommendations, bare-field detection, and climate simulation in one multilingual platform. Our team considered soil health, water availability, climate suitability, nitrogen fixation, and economic benefits while developing the solution.
